body.title: Week 8 immutable postgame audit and cross-week research diagnostics
body.body:
Grades all 52 ATS and 52 totals from PR #42's pregame seal against independently reconciled ESPN and CFBD scores. ATS: 26–26; totals: 23–29. Adds deterministic ledgers, Weeks 5–8 diagnostic tables, validated scoring-sequence review and numerical proposals labeled RESEARCH ONLY. CLV remains INCOMPLETE; no Week 8 owner approval is invented.

Exact audit head: **922f1f8f8c66ef14674eb9aa20db144a45dada68**. Dependencies are repaired aggregate #41 → #42. #43 is a sibling Week 9 ingest branch after #42, not a prerequisite for this audit; dependent #45 contains both #43 and #44. Do not merge defective ancestors without the #41 repairs.

Files: five new audit/capture/research scripts, tests/test_week8_postgame_audit.py, two evidence directories, docs/WEEK8_POSTGAME_ENGINEERING.md and additive .gitattributes rules. No schema, dependency, production model, weekly policy or historical artifact changes. Writers fail closed on existing output; verifiers require exact checksum coverage, consistent statuses and deterministic output bytes.

Fresh independent-checkout verification on October 29, using this exact PR head: **769 passed, 39 existing warnings, 195.39 seconds, exit 0**. HEAD before/after and clean tracked diffs are recorded. This is local Windows Python 3.12.14 execution, not GitHub CI. Eight read-only gates also pass. The separate #45 exact-head integration run passed 809 tests in 210.81s; these are distinct runs, not substitutions.

Executed with repository .venv Python:
```text
python -m pytest -q
python scripts/verify_repo_safety.py
python -m scripts.verify_migrations
python -m scripts.verify_cloud_migrations
python -m scripts.verify_week7_audit_integrity
python -m scripts.seal_week8_board --verify
python -m scripts.build_week8_postgame_audit --verify
python -m scripts.week8_scoring_sequence_review --verify
python -m scripts.week8_numerical_research --verify
```

All 104 picks reconcile; all 57 audit evidence files and 47 protected sources verify. All 52 scoring sequences validate. No selected-side backdoor covers meet the existing final-five-minutes definition; original conservative classifications remain preserved. One kickoff discrepancy is recorded separately without altering the frozen schedule. Original source DB SHA256 remains 09d0bcda684356001bacf8bc9e42939add56b053f405564d9be924e39c0cf842.

CI root cause is now established: authenticated GET actions/permissions returned **enabled:false**, although CI workflow 328094886 is active and PR-open events exist. There are zero recorded GitHub runs/checks/statuses. Main has no branch protection/rulesets; none were changed. Read-only token defaults and disabled automated PR approvals remain intact. Owner authorization is required for the documented plan to disable non-CI workflows before enabling repository Actions. No workflow was duplicated or security setting changed.

**HOLD.** Exact-head local tests and integrity gates pass, but independent GitHub CI and an independent approving reviewer remain outstanding. The only listed collaborator is author JCRABURN; the existing COMMENTED review is not APPROVED. No approval or merge is performed.

Limitations: missing timestamp-qualified historical closes; no owner-approved Week 8 five; retrospective Week 5–6 ranking evidence; small, correlated samples. Missing historical CLV alone does not block unrelated integrity code. The native aggregate whitespace check includes a trailing-space line in checksum-pinned audit code and historical evidence; those bytes are preserved, not silently reformatted. PR #46 supplies a separate explanation and clean PDF reading copies without suppressing findings.

[Fresh #44/#45 verification and provenance](https://github.com/JCRABURN/cfb-betting-system-v3/blob/8631d45f3bfed387f793aa86cccf2886fde8c7a4/outputs/2026-ci-merge-gates/20261029-investigation/FINAL_VERIFICATION.md) · [Full CI investigation](https://github.com/JCRABURN/cfb-betting-system-v3/blob/8631d45f3bfed387f793aa86cccf2886fde8c7a4/docs/CI_MERGE_GATE_RECONCILIATION.md) · [Preserved prior PR descriptions](https://github.com/JCRABURN/cfb-betting-system-v3/blob/8631d45f3bfed387f793aa86cccf2886fde8c7a4/outputs/2026-ci-merge-gates/20261029-investigation/pr-descriptions-before-ci-reconciliation.json)

Rollback: leave this audit unmerged or revert only its additive changes while retaining custody evidence. Migration checks use disposable copies; no source DB regeneration or recovery is needed. No original repository, NFL work, secrets or unrelated files changed. v2.8 remains unchanged.

Review of frozen Week 8 audit evidence: 52 ATS + 52 totals, 26–26 and 23–29, correctly preserved as separate cohorts with no invented owner-approved five. Research diagnostics properly distinguish calibration defects and CLV INCOMPLETE; no policy promotion. The audit-only diff against #42 is additive (78 files, one commit). Prior to merge, independently verify the integration tree and sealed source identities at the exact head, and preserve the repaired #41 ancestry; no GitHub CI checks/reviews are currently registered at this head. Historical missing CLV is not a reason to discard valid postgame arithmetic. No approval or merge is implied by this comment.

body.body:
Preserves the sealed Week 9 card of **54 ATS and 54 totals** from all six original SplashSports screenshots. The 56-game source excludes two elapsed Tuesday games. Original selections, lines, forecasts, model confidence, timestamps, source custody, mixed research Top 5 and v2.8 remain unchanged. Owner approval is **PENDING**.

The latest separate human Top 5 is **Northwestern +3.5 (2/5), Navy +30.5 (2/5), Southern Miss–ULM Under 56.5 (2/5), SMU–Syracuse Under 58.5 (1/5), Troy +20.5 (1/5)**. FAU–North Texas Under 77.5 moves to alternative rank 6. All ten alternatives and prior revisions are retained. Human confidence is ordinal and uncalibrated; no numerical injury/weather adjustment, calibration change or market-diversification quota was applied.

**Test-run reconciliation and exact identities**
- Requested reviewed head: db007694d3ee87d3a2b85feacd1fd9b7a2d10fb0.
- Current evidence-delivery head: 6e1948dd9b675a3f1226350ce5b40a6556e09f7a; 759 additive capture/review/reconciliation files only after db007694. Application/model/test/schema code is unchanged. A read-only descriptive research recipe is included under outputs.
- Earlier run A: e3a9a10ed63c0aa003d16e88208331d1ff81e170, 809 passed / 39 warnings / **203.82s**. Its original committed log and e3a9a10 gate identity remain unchanged.
- Earlier run B: **240.94s**, 809 passed / 39 warnings. Its previously temporary log and exact-head gate record are now archived byte-for-byte. Attribution to db007694 relies on the contemporaneous completion wrapper and separate metadata; the pytest text itself contains no SHA. File mtime and later archival hashes are not misrepresented as original execution proof.
- Fresh reconciliation run C: **809 passed / 39 warnings / 193.64s**, with db007694 recorded before and after execution, empty tracked diffs, exact command/cwd, start/end UTC, exit 0 and output hash. Started Oct 28 23:09:39 UTC; completed 23:12:54 UTC.
- The full-suite result applies to **db007694**, not the later evidence-delivery commit. A later October 29 exact-head run on 6e1948dd9b675a3f1226350ce5b40a6556e09f7a is now archived separately: **809 passed, 39 warnings, 210.81s**, HEAD before/after and clean tracked diffs. Eleven read-only gates also passed. It does not replace any of runs A/B/C. [New exact-head verification](https://github.com/JCRABURN/cfb-betting-system-v3/blob/8631d45f3bfed387f793aa86cccf2886fde8c7a4/outputs/2026-ci-merge-gates/20261029-investigation/FINAL_VERIFICATION.md).

[Reconciliation and limitations](https://github.com/JCRABURN/cfb-betting-system-v3/blob/6e1948dd9b675a3f1226350ce5b40a6556e09f7a/outputs/2026-week9-verification/20261028-reconciliation/RECONCILIATION.md) · [Run B preserved log](https://github.com/JCRABURN/cfb-betting-system-v3/blob/6e1948dd9b675a3f1226350ce5b40a6556e09f7a/outputs/2026-week9-verification/20261028-reconciliation/prior-db007694-240.94s.txt) · [Run C full log](https://github.com/JCRABURN/cfb-betting-system-v3/blob/6e1948dd9b675a3f1226350ce5b40a6556e09f7a/outputs/2026-week9-verification/20261028-reconciliation/fresh-db007694-full-suite.txt) · [Run C commit provenance](https://github.com/JCRABURN/cfb-betting-system-v3/blob/6e1948dd9b675a3f1226350ce5b40a6556e09f7a/outputs/2026-week9-verification/20261028-reconciliation/fresh-test-completion.json)

**Dependencies and protection**
Main abb4eb26bd1140e66972d2f1143cd587e80960b4; repaired #41 78ed6eb5540f66ba3193f91366c802e27e3cb9c7; #42 7f42da36f9aef4666bb715d49babde7ee374defa; #43 43807ae374b9db143c1d9675d7a7cafe6e2f28ba; #44 922f1f8f8c66ef14674eb9aa20db144a45dada68 are verified ancestors. The e3a9a10-to-db007694 diff is exactly 389 evidence/documentation additions, zero modifications/deletions. Fresh working-tree/Git-byte checks cover 118 protected files: 66 Week 8 audit, four additional Week 8 research, 44 Week 9 prospective and four morning-review files. The earlier shorthand “66 audit/research” is clarified in the report. Seal SHA256 remains 77aea6d0eefecc6dce014524610294da617d7dab2b6e903a59f8664f664e5460. **Verification executed**
Repository .venv Python, actual week9-execution worktree:
```text
python -m pytest -q
python -m scripts.verify_week7_audit_integrity
python -m scripts.seal_week8_board --verify
```

Eight read-only gates pass on db007694; diagnostic JSON replay is exact. Frozen formula/card/ranking and audit replay pass without live data or bypassing kickoff controls. The pregame database refit recorded Oct 28 at 22:42 UTC is preserved; no full-card generation was forced after kickoff. All 548 raw response hashes in the two new captures verify.

**Thursday decision evidence**
Troy’s official preview confirms Pettaway’s absence but also recurring Crowder injury. Last game Troy passed for 47 yards on 9/18. These are descriptive, opponent-dependent splits, not new forecasts. No evidence establishes that Pettaway absence outweighs Troy’s limitations. Troy stays a low-conviction fifth choice pending functional QB, OL and defense confirmation.

FAU/UNT’s 17.71-point gap is not a reliability estimate. Five archived audited games involving either team all exceeded forecast: bias/MAE +28.97, RMSE 32.00; all four Under picks lost. This is a small retrospective diagnostic, not a new calibration rule. Their latest games had 27/23 drive records and 139/129 scrimmage plays; explosive efficiency, return touchdowns and defensive scoring materially challenge the Under. Official notes report strong UNT OL continuity and low sacks allowed. Current depth charts are retained, but are not game-day medical clearance. Thursday wind is approximately 5 mph at UNT with 19–22% rain probability, not a strong Under signal.

[Current ten-candidate review](https://github.com/JCRABURN/cfb-betting-system-v3/blob/6e1948dd9b675a3f1226350ce5b40a6556e09f7a/outputs/2026-week9-owner-review/20261029-morning-decision/OWNER_REVIEW.md) · [Diagnostic calculations and source hashes](https://github.com/JCRABURN/cfb-betting-system-v3/blob/6e1948dd9b675a3f1226350ce5b40a6556e09f7a/outputs/2026-week9-verification/20261028-reconciliation/thursday-diagnostics.json)

Thursday capture: 158 successful nonweather records and 52 weather forecasts; two Wednesday games intentionally skipped. Their original rows remain intact. Latest ledger: 104 provider-attributed observations for 52 upcoming games, excluding started games. Quote timestamps/freshness and offered ATS/total juice unavailable; **CLV INCOMPLETE**, no claimed closes. Final Thursday review is scheduled before the 18:30 CDT kickoffs; already-started rows must remain identical and owner approval remains pending.

**Files, failures and limitations**
This follow-up adds two timestamped context directories, one new owner-review directory and a reconciliation directory containing preserved logs, provenance, diagnostic recipe/output and reports. [Initial 757-file inventory](https://github.com/JCRABURN/cfb-betting-system-v3/blob/6e1948dd9b675a3f1226350ce5b40a6556e09f7a/outputs/2026-week9-verification/20261028-reconciliation/delivery-files.txt) plus [two-file review supplement](https://github.com/JCRABURN/cfb-betting-system-v3/blob/6e1948dd9b675a3f1226350ce5b40a6556e09f7a/outputs/2026-week9-verification/20261028-reconciliation/delivery-supplement.json) identify all 759 additions. No schema migrations or test changes.

No unexplained test failures. Sun Belt availability endpoint returned HTTP 404; no stale or third-party report was promoted to official clearance. PDF extraction/font warnings were followed by visual checks. `git diff --cached --check` exits 2 for 6,419 trailing-space findings solely in three PDF plain-text extracts; the original evidence is preserved and the [formatting failure is documented](https://github.com/JCRABURN/cfb-betting-system-v3/blob/6e1948dd9b675a3f1226350ce5b40a6556e09f7a/outputs/2026-week9-verification/20261028-reconciliation/DIFF_REVIEW.md). Production/research recipe code has no such finding.

**CI root cause and merge**
Authenticated October 29 REST inspection proves repository Actions is **disabled (enabled:false)**, while the existing ci.yml workflow 328094886 is active on main and PR-open events exist. This is the current blocker behind zero GitHub runs/checks/statuses. No duplicate workflow or broader token permission is needed. Token defaults remain read-only and automated approval remains disabled. Main has no branch protection/rulesets; no security settings were changed.

**HOLD #44 and #45.** Exact current #45 head 6e1948dd9b675a3f1226350ce5b40a6556e09f7a now has a fresh 809-pass full-suite run and eleven passing read-only gates, but local Windows execution is not GitHub Ubuntu/Python 3.11 CI. Only JCRABURN is listed as collaborator; the two owner-authored COMMENTED reviews are not independent APPROVED reviews.

[Draft PR #46](https://github.com/JCRABURN/cfb-betting-system-v3/pull/46) preserves the API diagnosis, 125 protected file hashes, exact-head #44/#45 tests and clean reading copies of the three whitespace-heavy PDF extracts. It adds no blanket whitespace exclusion: original source bytes and all 6,421 full-diff findings remain visible. Its incremental diff passes. The CI-only activation plan requires owner approval to disable the six non-CI workflows before enabling repository Actions; an independent reviewer username is also required.

Exact dependency order is repaired #41 (includes #35–#40), then #42; #43 and #44 are sibling branches and may follow in either order; #45 requires both; #46 follows #45. Recheck the proposed merge tree after any base change. Historical missing CLV alone is not the CI blocker. No merge or approval is declared.

Week 9 review: 56 screenshot games reconcile; 2 elapsed Tuesday games excluded; frozen 54 ATS + 54 totals and source/lock custody are documented. Owner approval is expressly PENDING, and frozen model ranking is separated from the subjective five. Do not treat the proposed Northwestern/Navy/Southern Miss/SJSU/FAU list as approved. Key decision risks: governed ATS confidence is uniformly 1; mixed ATS/totals score scales are not calibrated; SJSU +14.5 and FAU–UNT Under 77.5 have human confidence 1 and unresolved QB/pace/possession risks. Oregon's 6.973/-2.092-point input sensitivity correctly must NOT be represented as a causal Moore valuation or added adjustment. FAU-UNT Under 77.5 is high risk given offensive/return-score tails.
